annotations.title: Kto wygrywa w branży i regionie

description: Who wins public tenders in a sector and region: the contractors that won the most tenders (sort='wins') or the highest total award value (sort='value') among finished tenders with the given CPV codes, in the given voivodeships (of the contracting authority), published in the given period — by default the last 24 months. A whole CPV division (e.g. '45000000') counts tenders whose main CPV code is in that division; a narrower code counts tenders with any CPV code under it, sub-codes included, as in search_archived_tenders (`cpv_codes[].match` says which). settled_tenders = tenders in that scope with a known winner; the award result is known for part of the finished tenders, less often for the latest months, and a very broad scope may not count in time (the answer then says so). Each contractor: wins (tenders won), parts_won, share_of_tenders (% of settled_tenders), value_pln (sum of the reliable award amounts of value_known_parts of its parts), last_win, NIP, and slug / url when it has a public page (get_contractor takes the slug). Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.

cpv_codes.description: CPV codes from cpv_search — the sector, e.g. ['79952000'] for events or ['45000000'] for all construction works

published_after.description: YYYY-MM-DD; published on or after that day

published_before.description: YYYY-MM-DD; published on or before that day

regions.description: Voivodeships (slug or name from list_facets); a tender matches any of them
